scope: 40 source-linked research dossiers across Mathematics (21), Quantum (4), Safety (7) and Systems (8). Preserves all 33 entries from the 2026-10-29 canonical ledger unchanged and adds seven separately scoped entries. Four mathematical additions are draft review summaries, not accepted theorems; the Judgment Provenance study has no results; five original-finding approvals, of which three belong to the original ledger whitelist, are unchanged.
criteria: separate topic mechanisms from serial project checkpoints
retain negative results when independent data illuminate failure mechanisms

entries.title: Erdős minimum overlap
entries.summary: 131,072-cell rational upper-bound witness with an internally replayed all-shift score of 0.380856370118029325…; external specialist audit remains open.
entries.boundary: An explicit construction and its exact audit; separate from the accepted Arena entry.

entries.title: Sidon (4,5): 30-point witness
entries.summary: A 30-integer configuration whose largest Sidon subset contains 17 elements, with an exhaustive finite checker.
entries.boundary: A distinct finite witness; existing asymptotic results remain credited to prior researchers.

entries.title: One-way planar Busy Beaver factorization
entries.summary: A proposed fresh-row decomposition relates one-way planar halting steps to the classical Busy Beaver function; its at-most-n phase factor remains unproved.
entries.boundary: Proof gap: repeated row-entry control states do not alone imply repeated global configurations. The n-phase upper bound is conjectural pending a valid invariant or proof.

entries.title: Finite-field span-tail reduction
entries.summary: Independent exact checkers establish a 2⁻⁹⁶ arithmetic tail envelope for stated large-field parameters under a span-count hypothesis.
entries.boundary: The central Gaussian short-vector span-count lemma and end-to-end decoder guarantee are unverified; arithmetic checks remain conditional.

entries.title: Nonabelian involution-shadow codes
entries.summary: Finite-group shadow encodings with exact distance, pair-spectrum and balanced erasure-allocation formulas, including nonabelian test cases.
entries.boundary: Algebraic manuscript and finite checks; formal-kernel verification and worldwide novelty audit still open.

entries.title: UP25: tight sign-uncertainty exclusion
entries.summary: An exact finite-dimensional Laguerre quadrature lower certificate sits within roughly 2.47×10⁻¹¹ of the archived degree-102 upper witness.
entries.boundary: The exclusion applies to the specified polynomial family, not the unrestricted uncertainty principle; upstream upper interval evidence is separately archived.

entries.title: Periodic forest-gauge obstruction
entries.summary: A periodic four-dimensional combinatorial defect identity, accompanied by a separate integer checker.
entries.boundary: Thirty-two representative finite checks reproduce the identity; universal proof and priority still require outside review.

entries.title: Affine source rigidity
entries.summary: September work on affine source collisions, shifted prime-series expansions, and rational dilation fibers.
entries.boundary: Analytic assumptions and originality remain under review.

entries.title: Factor-network compilation
entries.summary: A checked factor-network equality compiler with explicit structural certificates.
entries.boundary: Compiler behavior is reproducible; COPY tensors and factor-graph compilation are known constructions.

entries.title: ETH Hermite taper and rank barrier
entries.summary: An interpolation precision allowance improvement and a lower bound for restricted disjoint middle-layer refinements.
entries.boundary: A restricted obstruction result, with no claimed new SAT worst-case exponent.

entries.title: Selection-aware Gaussian pivoting
entries.summary: A selected-row Gaussian spectral-tail analysis that retains triangular elimination loss.
entries.boundary: The final matrix-growth-factor improvement remains open.

entries.title: First-autocorrelation integer certificates
entries.summary: Mass-preserving transport, score-invariant grid splitting and three-prime NTT/CRT reproduce a 4,096-cell step-function score.
entries.boundary: The certified 1.515612… construction trails the October 20 leaderboard; this is exact finite methodology, not a record.

entries.title: Zerothesis: dormant-support activations
entries.summary: Five nonzero-support births improved a public-seed 100,000-point convolution score by approximately 2.54×10⁻¹²; two scorers agreed.
entries.boundary: A modification of an externally sourced seed; the gain is below the contest improvement threshold and does not establish a global result.

entries.title: Five BB(6) arithmetic return maps
entries.summary: Five named six-state cryptid systems receive source-dependent macro return formulas, with 172,816 reported rule-level comparisons.
entries.boundary: Finite symbolic transitions only; imported machine tables and macro guards require independent replay, with no nonhalting classification.

entries.title: Minimum overlap: fixed-dual lower audit
entries.summary: An eight-row exact rational mean-cover certificate reports a conditional universal lower value of 0.38062747462668, plus a fixed-family saturation limit.
entries.boundary: Relies on inherited Wetch kernel/Arb interval premises; its bound is separate from the finite upper witness and needs fresh source-integral replay.

entries.type: Algebraic proof candidate · exact finite tests
entries.title: Deterministic adaptive finite-field decoder
entries.summary: Axiom's two-round extension-degree packed decoder uses at most k+⌈(k−1)/(r−1)⌉ powered measurements (q>2); k+1 is globally optimal for 2≤k≤r. The independent checker passes 332,086 vectors and 3,000 nonadaptive collision certificates.
entries.boundary: Noiseless K-linear adaptive sensing, global F_q× equivalence, explicit extension-field representation; q=2 has exact optimum k. External proof and publication-priority reviews open. Classic complement-property precedent is credited.

entries.title: Fixed-field adaptive phase separation
entries.summary: A proposed all-dimensional separation over the same GF9 square-powered linear sensing oracle: an adaptive upper construction is combined with the classical fixed-design complement obstruction.
entries.boundary: Draft PR #256, with dependent refinements #264–266. All-k proofs, model-matched priority and non-author mathematical review remain open; lower-bound refinements do not by themselves establish global novelty.

entries.title: F16 adaptive three-phase compression
entries.summary: A branch-dependent two-query F16 cubic phase gadget distinguishes 27 relative-phase states and gives proposed six-query k=4 and eleven-query k=7 adaptive constructions.
entries.boundary: Draft PR #255 with internal independent arithmetic replays. The proof applies to the specified powered oracle and counts adaptive branches; kernel-level all-signal theorem and worldwide priority remain open.

entries.type: Affine-incidence rigidity theorem candidate · draft PR
entries.title: Intrinsic recovery of glued planar maps
entries.summary: A proposed hyperplane and codimension-two incidence reconstruction of two glued quadratic planar-map components over F₃ⁿ, intended to hold uniformly for n≥3.
entries.boundary: Draft PR #203: the scalar-fiber bound, full incidence classification and ambient affine recovery need independent proof attack and dated same-hypothesis priority review; this is not a new Sidon extremal bound.

entries.title: Uniform cubic graph covers with girth 14
entries.summary: A proposed degree-uniform family of connected cubic bipartite covers, constructed through finite-field voltages with a girth-14 and 32-cycle certificate.
entries.boundary: Draft PR #204. The cycle-polynomial exhaustion, all-degree primitive-element argument, connectivity and simplicity conditions remain under review; no Erdős–Gyárfás solution or global record is claimed.

entries.type: Exact finite synthesis · general proofs under review
entries.title: Sidon insertion arity transition
entries.summary: Single-point matching, simultaneous insertion and a growing high-incidence core are connected by a common collision-support hypergraph; a 91-element source has a complete two-point repair census.
entries.boundary: The 81 single insertions and 3,240 outside pairs are internally audited finite cases. Component universal algorithms and linear-core claims remain unreviewed; no new asymptotic density or hardness result follows.

entries.title: Werner finite-copy evidence atlas
entries.summary: Separates 4–20 qutrit and all-dimension thresholds, reported 21–24 improvements and symbolic 25–100 continuation.
entries.boundary: Historic 6–9 alternatives and imported 4-/5-copy SDP margins remain separate until original source witnesses are independently checked.

entries.title: Werner 24–25-copy rational certificates
entries.summary: Exact-rational downstream certificates report qutrit thresholds 0.34636 at 24 copies and 0.34584 at 25 copies under lower-copy theorems.
entries.boundary: Distinct from the approved 4–20 registry; original quantitative source inequalities and full scope still require outside replay.

entries.title: Complementary-syndrome gluing
entries.summary: A syndrome-difference selection rule extends the affine-code theorem to coherent rank-two witnesses on 27×27 supports.
entries.boundary: Colliding syndrome differences create cross terms; the original source PDF and checker archive are separate from this curated digest.

entries.title: Ternary diagonal rigidity obstruction
entries.summary: A Hamming-parity and symplectic argument bounds positive diagonal coordinate supports by 2ᵏ and classifies the binary-cube extremizers.
entries.boundary: An ambient diagonal-subspace obstruction, not a claim of unrestricted rank-two positivity; outside novelty review remains open.

entries.title: Agent Safety Under Abstraction
entries.summary: A September analysis of observation fibers, collateral-denial effects, provenance composition, and agent-side information limits.
entries.boundary: Classical factorization results are identified; stronger authority claims require proof and priority review.

entries.title: AI safety theorem-and-evidence series
entries.summary: An integrated September–October account of observation sufficiency, authority, oversight, and adversarial provenance.
entries.boundary: Distinguishes finite checks and manuscript dependencies from independently established new guarantees.

entries.title: SourceBound evidence prototype
entries.summary: An implementation track for source admission, claim provenance, and evidence-aware responses.
entries.boundary: Natural-web controlled effectiveness remains an open evaluation; overlapping prior products are credited.

entries.title: Counterfactual authorization gap
entries.summary: Formal models of reference-class capability envelopes, audit burden, and composition-induced escape.
entries.boundary: The status is a theoretical manuscript requiring external proof and priority review.

entries.title: Hidden-function interpretability
entries.summary: Paired observational and causal residual checks, an exact small-state demonstration, and a blinded evaluation design.
entries.boundary: The example is limited in scale; empirical generalization awaits controlled tests.

entries.title: Causal cuts and research selection
entries.summary: Directed-cut factorization, evaluation transport, and obstruction-pair reasoning for decision-oriented research.
entries.boundary: The finite algebraic examples and synthetic studies carry no general causal discovery theorem.

entries.title: Judgment Provenance: blinded independent review
entries.summary: A proposed randomized three-arm study asks whether freezing a human judgment before agent exposure reduces agent-induced preference movement without sacrificing methodological quality.
entries.boundary: Protocol JP-01 only: zero participants, zero experimental outcome estimates, ethics and study preregistration still required. It does not demonstrate that blind review works.

entries.title: From Search to Certificate
entries.summary: An observational reconstruction of the October multi-agent mathematical search, agent handoffs, structural transitions and exact-certification controls.
entries.boundary: Historical observational study; no randomized causal inference of agent effectiveness, and leaderboard status differs from mathematical validity.

entries.title: Autonomous scientific verification
entries.summary: A proof-carrying workflow specifies isolated reproducer, adversarial auditor and formalizer roles with deterministic artifact-based verdict gates.
entries.boundary: A working protocol with finite examples; agent agreement cannot certify an unproved theorem or replace independent source verification.

entries.title: PAS: 372-family priority freeze
entries.summary: A reproducible ranking of 372 released theorem families with published manifest checksums and a prospective correction-prediction test.
entries.boundary: The historical private freeze lacks third-party timestamping, and prospective predictive efficacy is untested.

entries.title: Proof After Scarcity
entries.summary: The archived 20-case ranking study produced 8/20 versus an upstream-first 11/20 baseline.
entries.boundary: An informative bounded negative outcome; no claimed general superiority.

entries.title: NIGHTFALL Discovery Engine
entries.summary: Reproducible search contracts, representation changes, exact replay, falsification controls, and adaptive-resolution experiments.
entries.boundary: Prototype and synthetic evidence; domain-wide improvements await held-out, matched-budget evaluation.

entries.title: Adaptive granularity: matched-budget trial
entries.summary: A held-out two-domain proxy compares fixed, event-adaptive and trained boundaries; the trained selector favored the atomic baseline.
entries.boundary: A corrected synthetic experiment, not an efficiency gain for actual mathematical discovery or natural-web SourceBound.

entries.title: Competition and negative-result registry
entries.summary: Erdős, C1/C2, UP25, rejected submissions, provenance conflicts, and unsuccessful operators in one evidence-aware chronology.
entries.boundary: Leaderboard standing, mathematical validity, and source completeness are tracked separately.

entries.title: NIGHTFALL Lean Compiler Bridge
entries.summary: A pinned Lean 4 toolchain wrapper, named-declaration axiom inspection and CI receipts provide a reusable path from a source theorem to an inspectable compiler result.
entries.boundary: An integration with official Lean, not a new prover. Only specifically compiled declarations are kernel-checked; this does not formalize the draft general theorems, certify originality or replace human proof review.
